name: HemOncFHIRRegimenCatalog
title: HemOnc FHIR Regimen Catalog — Executable Knowledge Layer for Oncology Protocols
description:
FHIR R4 projection of the HemOnc Knowledge Base (HemOncKB) as executable
knowledge artifacts (PlanDefinition, ActivityDefinition, MedicationKnowledge,
Library, CodeSystem, ConceptMap). Companion to the German MII Onkologie module
and aligned with the HL7 Europe PHOENIX Cancer Common Model initiative.
Developed in cooperation with HemOnc.org / OHDSI Oncology / HL7-EU PHOENIX /
MII Onkologie. CC BY 4.0.
